heading: Services this site can use
withdrawn: All choices withdrawn. Each service will ask again.
serviceSends_google_analytics: Counts visits and pages read. Google receives your IP address and may set cookies.
serviceSends_youtube: Plays videos from YouTube. Google receives your IP address and may set cookies.
serviceSends_vimeo: Plays videos from Vimeo. Vimeo receives your IP address; this site asks it not to track you.
serviceSends_google_maps: Shows maps from Google Maps. Google receives your IP address and may set cookies.
serviceSends_speech: When your browser can't understand speech on your device, your voice goes to its speech service (Google, Apple or Microsoft).
serviceSends_github: Shows repository cards and other content from GitHub. GitHub receives your IP address and may set cookies.
serviceSends_webstatus: Shows Baseline browser support badges from webstatus.dev, a Google Chrome project. Google receives your IP address.
serviceSends_aframe: Loads the A-Frame library from aframe.io to show 3D scenes. aframe.io receives your IP address.
serviceSends_embed: Shows content from {host}. {host} receives your IP address and may set cookies.
